gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Approachable letters in Noto Sans Lydian, with capitals barely taller than lowercase and wide, springy openings. Redux earns its place big and brief, with its pen-like bowls.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Modern lowercase stands tall in Noto Sans Mahajani, its e funneled wide open. Redux brings widely spaced, geometric headings with moderate shading, and the sans-serif body stays nearly invisible beneath them, which is the pair's quiet strength.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Approachable and professional, Noto Sans Malayalam builds a dense middle zone in each line, with an s that opens generously between its bends. Redux leads with mild tapering.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Neutral curves in Noto Sans Mandaic feel unclamped, with lowercase rising close to the capitals. And Redux, with hairline-free thin strokes beside moderately weighty stems, leaves a long stretch of sans text feeling loose and unhurried.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Noto Sans Marchen reads clean, its small letters nearly capital-sized. Redux adds widely spaced geometry up top, with slightly thinner curves, and the sans-serif text below stays clear and unfussy.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-mayan-nume: Noto Sans Mayan Numerals reads tall-bodied and contemporary, its c gaping visibly at any size. And Redux, with its noticeable stroke contrast above, lets a long stretch of text move along without any strain.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-medefaidri: Noto Sans Medefaidrin lifts its lowercase high, and its curves turn in without any ink pooling. And Redux, modest in its thick-thin shifts, leaves a longer stretch of sans-serif text feeling crisp and unhurried.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-meetei-may: Redux enters every curve with a big visible swing, its weight shifting gradually instead of snapping. Noto Sans Meetei Mayek handles the sustained reading, with large lowercase eyes.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-mende-kika: Noto Sans Mende Kikakui lets daylight through every curve. Redux's stems, only a shade heavier than their arms, hand off to tall lowercase that carries a long stretch of sans text smoothly.
